description: This file is a Perl script used for managing package metadata, dependencies, configuration, and generating various JSON reports within a software build system, specifically for a project related to OpenWrt. It contains functions for version parsing, package dependency resolution, configuration overrides, and producing CycloneDX SBOM reports.

methods.name: version_to_num
methods.description: Converts a version string with dot notation into a numerical value for comparison.

methods.name: version_filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of version strings based on comparison operators and a baseline version.

methods.name: gen_kconfig_overrides
methods.description: Generates Kconfig override configurations based on package info and build system settings.

methods.name: __find_package_dep
methods.description: Recursively checks if a package depends on another package by name.

methods.name: find_package_dep
methods.description: Wrapper to avoid infinite recursion in dependency checks.

methods.name: package_depends
methods.description: Determines the dependency relationship between two packages.

methods.name: mconf_depends
methods.description: Generates dependency configuration for menuconfig based on package dependencies.

methods.name: mconf_conflicts
methods.description: Generates conflict configuration entries for packages.

methods.name: add_implicit_provides_conflicts
methods.description: Adds conflict entries among default variants of virtual packages.

methods.name: print_package_config_category
methods.description: Prints a menuconfig category with contained package configs.

methods.name: print_package_overrides
methods.description: Prints overrides for package configurations.

methods.name: gen_package_config
methods.description: Main function that generates the entire package configuration menu, including categories and packages.

methods.name: and_condition
methods.description: Converts a logical AND condition into a syntax suitable for configuration.

methods.name: gen_condition
methods.description: Transforms a logical condition into a string expression for dependencies.

methods.name: get_conditional_dep
methods.description: Wraps dependency strings with conditional expressions based on configuration conditions.

methods.name: gen_package_mk
methods.description: Generates makefile snippets for packages based on package metadata.

methods.name: gen_package_source
methods.description: Outputs source file information for packages.

methods.name: gen_package_auxiliary
methods.description: Generates auxiliary variables for packages such as repository paths and dependencies.

methods.name: gen_package_license
methods.description: Outputs package license information, optionally including license files.

methods.name: gen_version_filtered_list
methods.description: Outputs a filtered list of version strings based on a specified version filter.

methods.name: gen_usergroup_list
methods.description: Outputs a list of user and group assignments from package metadata.

methods.name: gen_package_manifest_json
methods.description: Creates a JSON manifest of packages with their dependencies, license, and other metadata.

methods.name: image_manifest_packages
methods.description: Reads an image manifest file to extract listed packages.

methods.name: dump_cyclonedxsbom_json
methods.description: Produces a CycloneDX SBOM JSON representation from components.

methods.name: gen_image_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON for an image based on its package manifest and image manifest.

methods.name: gen_package_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON for a package manifest file.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses CLI commands and dispatches to relevant functions.
